units.source_text: 比如說，當我看完照片合上眼，這張臉就被我忘得一乾二淨了。

en.t: For example, once I finish looking at the photograph and close my eyes, I forget that face completely.

units.source_text: 雖然還記得房間內的牆壁、小火盆，但對於房間內主人公的印象，卻煙消雲散，怎麼也想不起來。

en.t: Although I can still remember the walls of the room and the small brazier, my impression of the person at the center of the room vanishes like smoke, and no matter how hard I try, I cannot recall it.

units.source_text: 那是一張無法畫成畫的臉，甚至連漫畫也畫不成。

en.t: It was a face that could not be turned into a picture, not even into a caricature.

units.source_text: 睜開眼睛看過後，我甚至不會產生「啊，想起來了，原來長這模樣啊」這樣的愉悅感。

en.t: Even after opening my eyes and looking at it, I do not feel even the pleasure of thinking, Ah, now I remember, so this is what he looked like.

units.source_text: 用更極端的說法，即使睜開眼再看這張照片，也不會想起那張臉，只會變得愈發不愉快和焦慮，最終只好移開視線。

en.t: To put it more extremely, even if I open my eyes and look at the photograph again, I cannot remember that face; I only become more unpleasantly unsettled and anxious, until in the end I have no choice but to look away.
